root_cause.text: The `fl_release()` function prematurely frees an exclusive flowlabel's option block (`fl->opt`) when its user count drops to zero, while the enclosing `struct ip6_flowlabel` remains visible in the global hash table and accessible to concurrent RCU readers.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the code block in `fl_release()` that immediately calls `kfree(opt)` on `fl->opt` when `fl->share == IPV6_FL_S_EXCL`, deferring the deallocation of the option block until the enclosing flowlabel is torn down via RCU in `fl_free_rcu()`.
